caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a rectangular top that has slightly rounded corners and a glossy finish, primarily in shades of brown and reddish-brown, with visible wood grain patterns. The table has two drawers on the lengthwise side, each featuring a round brass knob. It stands on two pedestal legs, each composed of a central turned column that extends into a pair of curved, splayed feet. The feet are accented with what appears to be brass or gold-colored fittings or casters at the ends. The table casts a faint shadow beneath it, adding depth to the illustration. The background is plain and unadorned, and near the top left of the drawing, the word "Redraw" is written in a cursive script. The composition centers the table, with slight pencil construction lines still visible.
title: Sofa Table
